title: Ancient Awakening
start: Talk to overseer Siv in Fort Forinthry.

recommended.t: Salve amulet or salve amulet (e) for increased damage and accuracy against most of the enemies encountered
Slayer cape or Fort Forinthry lodestone to teleport to the Raptor
Combat bracelet or Varrock lodestone for travel to the west of the Champions' Guild

rewards.t: 15000 Necromancy XP lamp (Skill must be level 50 or higher)
10000 Skill XP lamp (Skill must be level 50 or higher)
Access to the standard difficulty of the Ungael combat activity
Ability to build all three tiers of the Botanist's Workbench at Fort Forinthry

steps.t: Talk to Overseer Siv in the Command Centre in the Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 2 Talk about 'Ancient Awakening'. › Accept › Any]
Go north of Fort Forinthry and enter the Wilderness crypt entrance. Pray Protect from Magic against the risen ghosts inside.
Go across the bridge and enter the ancient door.

sub.t: If the bridge is missing, log out and back in to have it reappear.

steps.t: Talk to any character near the map table. [Chat: Any › Any › Any]

Collect 20 dragonkin artefacts in the tomb. Kill any tomb zombies that appear, and then collect the artefacts they drop. The zombies are based on your combat level, e.g. 3,200 life points at combat level 152. One can be collected from each Dragonkin artefact hotspot throughout the crypt as well.
Talk to anyone near the map table again. [Chat: Any]
Go to the Jolly Boar Inn, south-west of Fort Forinthry. Use the marker to continue the quest at the entrance, then stay on the floor 1.
Talk to Bill at the bar. [Chat: 2 I don't need to know your family history, Bill.]
Go up the staircase, talk to Ellamaria. [Chat: 4 Let's skip the small talk.]
Continue the quest with the quest marker west of the Champions' Guild. The marker is to the west of the stone bridge but before the wooden bridge.
Talk to Aster slightly south, by the Waddle Willow. [Chat: 3 I need you to return to the fort.]
Go back to Fort Forinthry, continue Ancient Awakening at the Town Hall.
Talk to anyone in the Town Hall.
Leave through the marker at the entrance to the Town Hall. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Gear up for combat.

sub.t: Most of the enemies are weak to magic (earth or fire spells)

steps.t: Go to the Grove east of the fort and interact with the rowboat to travel to Ungael. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Kill all of the attacking monsters.
Talk to the team and make your way north-east up the path.
Interact with the Ruins Entrance.
Go up the stairs to the north-east, then head west. Interact with the tower entrance. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Watch the cutscene.

Defeat 12 waves of Zemouregal's minions. After each wave of enemies, you have to activate necrotic energy and sometimes choose a power-up for one of your allies. See the full guide for details on all waves and power-ups.
Watch the cutscene.
Talk to Aster. [Chat: Any]
Interact with the doorway to the south.
Walk west, then south, then interact with runic projector.
Collect three motes of energy from:

sub.t: Go north to catch the mote just outside the tower.
Searching bookcase inside the tower on the north side.
Searching ruined pillar in the south-west.

steps.t: Interact with the runic projector.
Listen to the archivist. [Chat: Any › 2 What is this place? › 3 Tell me about Vorkath. › 4 Tell me about this tomb. › 1 Can you activate this conduit?]
Inspect the mysterious device to the south-east.
Finish the conversation.
Return to Fort Forinthry and continue via the marker in front of the Town Hall.
Talk to anyone in the Town Hall.
